method_notes: Live superset from ORD PrimaryRoleId RO197 (247) + RO57 (0 this week) + RO107 (4) = 251 trusts, and RO261 filtered to names containing INTEGRATED CARE BOARD = 48 ICBs. 61 codes present in ORD but absent from the DBs were fetched individually; 58 carry a Date[Legal].End in the past (legally dissolved, correctly absent) and are not reported. Change feed since 2026-09-12 returned 1267 changed orgs, none of which are in either DB.
